territorial_scope.description: Applies to pricing conduct of platform operators and in-platform operators within mainland China.

evidence.quote: 平台经营者、平台内经营者在中华人民共和国境内

summary.short: China's Internet Platform Price Conduct Rules set price-related duties and prohibitions for platform operators and in-platform operators selling goods or services online. They apply from 10 April 2026 for a stated validity of 5 years.
summary.long: The rules govern pricing conduct by platform operators and in-platform operators that sell goods or provide services through internet platforms in mainland China. Platform operators may not restrict in-platform operators' pricing autonomy through fee increases, traffic limits, search demotion or delisting, and must publish fee standards and seek in-platform operators' opinions for at least seven days before changing fees. Sellers must display prices and fees clearly, disclose dynamic pricing and personalised pricing rules, and state the conditions of promotions and estimated prices. Operators may not sell below cost to exclude competitors, use data and algorithms to set different prices for the same transaction without consumers' knowledge, collude on prices, or spread false price-rise information. Price fraud and misleading price displays are prohibited. Consumers must be shown and able to cancel no-password payment, bundled services and automatic renewal. Platform operators must maintain a price compliance system, handle personal information lawfully and complete required algorithm filings. The Development and Reform, market regulation and cyberspace authorities supervise compliance. Minor violations that are corrected promptly and cause no harm are not administratively penalised.

notes: The source is a layout-extracted copy. The Art. 29 heading and its text ('年。') are split across pages; the stated validity of 5 years is read from that fragment. The text states entry into force on 2026-04-10 and does not state an expiry date. Scope in Art. 2 covers platform operators and in-platform operators, while Art. 27 extends the rules to self-built websites by reference (参照适用). Art. 14 contains a carve-out for long-term free business models. No internal numeric inconsistencies were found.

obligations.summary: Encourages platform operators and in-platform operators to innovate technology and business models; no further conduct specified.

evidence.quote: 鼓励平台经营者、平台内经营者创新技术和商业模式

obligations.summary: Platform operators may not impose unreasonable restrictions on in-platform operators' pricing through fee increases, deductions, traffic limits, search demotion, delisting or similar measures, including forced discounts, price parity and forced automatic price-matching systems.

evidence.quote: 平台经营者不得违反《中华人民共和国电子商务法》第三十五条规定

obligations.summary: Before adding or changing fee items, rules or standards, platform operators must publicly seek opinions from in-platform operators on the homepage for at least seven days and adopt transition measures where material.

evidence.quote: 应当在首页显著位置公开征求平台内经营者的意见，征求意见时间不少于七日

obligations.summary: Platform operators must set fee standards for in-platform operators reasonably and publish them, may not charge unreasonable fees, and may not prevent in-platform operators that reject changes from exiting the platform.

evidence.quote: 平台经营者不得阻止

obligations.summary: Platform operators and in-platform operators must mark prices and fees clearly (item name, price, unit, service content, and shipping, delivery, payment and unavoidable fees prominently).

evidence.quote: 应当对销售的商品或者提供的服务实行明码标价

obligations.summary: Platform operators and in-platform operators may not add charges above the marked price or collect unmarked fees.

evidence.quote: 在标价之外加价、收取任何未予标明的费用

obligations.summary: Differential pricing for consumers under different transaction conditions and dynamic pricing (e.g., time-based) must have rules publicly disclosed on the service page, with factors affecting prices explained and extra service fees shown separately; rules must be updated when changed.

evidence.quote: 应当在服务页面显著位置公开相关规则，如有变动应当及时更新

obligations.summary: Paid ancillary services sold with goods (e.g., moving, installation, extended warranty) must be priced prominently; services not provided by the seller must be marked as such.

evidence.quote: 应当在显著位置对附带服务进行明码标价

obligations.summary: Promotional prices or promotion rules must be marked in a way consumers can readily understand; promotion rules, periods and scope must be disclosed prominently, true base prices stated, and points or vouchers' offset methods specified.

evidence.quote: 应当以方便消费者认知的方式标明促销价格或者价格促销规则

obligations.summary: Platform operators may not falsely or exaggeratedly advertise subsidy amounts or strength; subsidy promotions must also disclose subsidy rules, targets, methods, conditions and periods on the activity page.

evidence.quote: 不得虚假、夸大宣传补贴金额和力度

obligations.summary: Estimated prices must disclose their composition and prominently warn that they may differ from the final settlement price; payment or other restrictions must be shown in advance.

evidence.quote: 应当公开预估价格的构成

obligations.summary: Search results must be displayed by price, sales, credit or other factors; paid ranking must be marked as advertising, and ranking, recommendation and bidding rules must be disclosed to participating operators.

evidence.quote: 对于竞价排名的商品或者服务，应当显著标明“广告”

obligations.summary: Below-cost sales aimed at excluding competitors or monopolising a market and disrupting normal business order are prohibited; platforms may not force in-platform operators to price below cost; long-term free business models are carved out under conditions.

evidence.quote: 以排挤竞争对手或者独占市场为目的，以低于成本的价格销售商品或者提供服务

obligations.summary: Setting different prices for the same goods or services under the same transaction conditions by using data and algorithms without consumers' knowledge is prohibited; platform operators may not price-discriminate against in-platform operators.

evidence.quote: 在同等交易条件下设置不同的价格或者收费标准

obligations.summary: Using platform rules, data and algorithms to collude with others and manipulate market prices, harming other operators or consumers, is prohibited.

evidence.quote: 利用平台规则、数据和算法等手段，相互串通，操纵市场价格

obligations.summary: Fabricating or spreading price-increase information, hoarding goods, forced bundling and similar acts to inflate prices are prohibited; for emergency and essential goods during emergencies, sharp unjustified price or transport-fee increases are prohibited.

evidence.quote: 捏造、散布涨价信息，哄抬价格，推动商品价格过高上涨

obligations.summary: Price fraud is prohibited, including falsely claiming government pricing, low-price baiting, false discounts, deceptive price displays, refusing price commitments, and refusing to honour points or vouchers.

evidence.quote: 谎称商品和服务价格为政府定价或者政府指导价

obligations.summary: Platform operators may not display prices on the homepage or prominent positions lower than the price on the detail page, may not misstate promotion scope or rules, and may not compel false price displays.

evidence.quote: 在平台首页或者其他显著位置标示的商品或者服务的价格低于在详情页面标示的价格

obligations.summary: For password-free (免密) payment, bundled extra services and auto-renewal or auto-deduction, options must be shown prominently with an easy cancellation path; before each auto-deduction consumers must be notified of time, amount and cancellation method, and cancellation must be allowed at any time.

evidence.quote: 应当以显著方式向消费者展示相关选项，并提供便捷的取消途径

obligations.summary: Disguised price changes through raising or lowering grades, falsely increasing quantity or duration, or similar means are prohibited.

evidence.quote: 不得违反《中华人民共和国价格法》第十四条第六项规定

obligations.summary: Platform operators are encouraged to establish an online price-dispute resolution mechanism with published rules, and to establish quality commitment and guarantee systems.

evidence.quote: 鼓励平台经营者建立价格争议在线解决机制

obligations.summary: The development and reform, market regulation and cyberspace authorities supervise price conduct in the platform economy; they may warn, admonish and summon operators, investigate operating conditions, and market regulators conduct inspections and penalise violations.

evidence.quote: 发展改革、市场监管、网信部门依职责对平台经济领域价格行为开展监管

obligations.summary: Platform operators and in-platform operators must truthfully provide information required by the development and reform, market regulation and cyberspace authorities.

evidence.quote: 应当按照发展改革、市场监管、网信部门的要求，如实提供所需信息

obligations.summary: Platform operators must establish and improve price-conduct compliance management, including internal rules, platform rules guiding in-platform compliance, price supervisors, product quality controls and personal-data handling in price conduct.

evidence.quote: 建立健全价格行为合规管理制度

obligations.summary: Platform operators must establish and publicise a channel for price complaints and take necessary measures promptly to stop violations.

evidence.quote: 设立、公示价格问题投诉渠道

obligations.summary: Platform operators must properly retain price and transaction information within the platform and assist market regulators in investigating price violations.

evidence.quote: 妥善保存平台内有关价格和交易信息

obligations.summary: Platform operators must carry out legally required algorithm filing procedures for price conduct and cooperate with cyberspace and other authorities on security assessment and supervision.

evidence.quote: 依法履行价格行为有关算法备案手续

obligations.summary: The National Development and Reform Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation and Cyberspace Administration of China are responsible for interpreting the rules within their respective duties.

evidence.quote: 依职责负责解释

enforcement.authority: 发展改革、市场监管、网信部门 (Development and Reform, Market Regulation and Cyberspace Affairs departments)
enforcement.triggered_by: Not stated in the text; discretionary measures the three departments may take, jointly with relevant departments, against platform operators and in-platform operators

evidence.quote: 发展改革、市场监管、网信部门可以会同相关部门对平台经营者、平台内经营者进行提醒、告诫和约谈

enforcement.authority: 市场监管部门 (market regulation departments)
enforcement.triggered_by: Violations of the Rules; the text does not specify which provisions. Art. 23 para. 3 provides supervision and inspection of operating conduct and investigation and punishment of violations as provided by law
enforcement.max_penalty_text: None stated in this text; the text refers generally to punishment of violations as provided by law (依法查处违法行为) and does not state any sanction amount.
enforcement.penalty_reference: Not stated in this text. The Rules cite the Price Law, E-Commerce Law, Anti-Unfair Competition Law, Consumer Rights Law and Administrative Penalty Law (Art. 1, Arts. 5, 7, 14-21, Art. 26) without citing their penalty articles
enforcement.cure_period: Art. 26: minor violations promptly corrected without harmful consequences are not administratively penalized under the Administrative Penalty Law

evidence.quote: 市场监管部门对平台经营者、平台内经营者相关经营行为开展监督检查，依法查处违法行为。

thresholds.note: No numeric cutoff changing legal treatment was found. The seven-day consultation period (Art. 6) is a procedural limit and the five-year validity term (Art. 29) is a duration, so neither is coded as a threshold.
